posts.text:
Protecting Michiganders and their property is our top priority. 

With already high water levels across the state and more rain in the forecast, we will keep monitoring the situation and supporting local communities with the resources they need.

Tonight, I signed an executive order to temporarily suspend motor carrier regulations for driver hours to stabilize fuel supplies in key areas of northern Michigan. This action will support local communities, first responders, and utility crews as they work to keep people safe.

Today, we broke ground on The William Schma House, an affordable place for Michiganders to call home and get back on their feet. This housing community will give Michiganders stability and support as they rebuild their lives and imagine a future filled with possibility.

Every mom deserves a healthy pregnancy and postpartum.
 
We’re working hard to expand access to health care, close racial health gaps, and make Michigan the best place to raise a family.

Video

With 10 million bosses, I always love meeting with my favorites 🫶

Video

Thank you to the first responders who are working to keep people safe. To everyone in Cheboygan, please stay updated and follow guidance from your local emergency manager. 

Michiganders are tough. I know we’ll get through this together.

Today, I’m declaring a State of Emergency in Cheboygan County to coordinate ongoing work around the Cheboygan Dam.

This emergency declaration will help local, state, and federal officials protect Michiganders and property from flooding following record snowfall and recent rain.

Teachers make a world of difference for their students.
 
When they’re set up for success, we get one step closer to helping every child read.

Video

These are the faces of the heroes that keep our state happy and healthy. Every day they are on the frontlines protecting our health and wellbeing.

This Public Health Week and always, we say thank you to every public health worker across our state.

We’re so back… to fixing the damn roads 💪

Video

Caught up with our favorite new Michigander, Jase!

Video

It was great to welcome home @QuinnXCII for his From Michigan With Love tour! 

You always have ✋ to call home 🫶

You know the ads, you know the billboards, you know the catchphrase -- you know Pure Michigan.
 
It's in our lakes and our air, our laughs and our people, we attract travelers from all across the world because no one does pure like Michigan.

Fix the damn roads season is here! With a whole new construction season, we’ve got another chance to put the pedal to the metal on fixing local roads.

We’ve got the funds, we’ve got the crews, we’ve got the drive, let’s get it done.

Nothing like tackling the problems of tomorrow over pancakes! 

It’s great to be back for Pancakes & Politics, an event that reminds us we are stronger when we work towards what brings us together: a growing economy, good-paying jobs, and a brighter future.

Michigan is THE place for bold, bright ideas. We’re a state that drives innovation and gets shit done. That is the fuel behind every business who shared their vision at Pitch MI. 

Michigan will keep showing up for small business the way they show up for our us.
